title: The Cave That Grew Its Teeth Back
story: The mouth of Skarnhollow's cave is barred by 30 razor icicles, and a caravan of traders is trapped inside. Every time Mr 6 knocks two icicles down, three new ones creep back from the cave roof — but the roof only holds so much frost, and each knock costs a minute. Mr 6 counts before he swings.
question: Starting from 30 icicles, if each swing removes 2 but 3 regrow, how many icicles bar the cave after 12 swings?
hint: Work out the net change from a single swing — does the number go up or down by how much? Then repeat it 12 times.
victory: Mr 6 realized swinging only ADDED one icicle a time, so he stopped at nothing, breathed warm air on the roots instead, and the whole frozen gate slumped into slush as the traders cheered.
imagePrompt: A cave mouth fringed with glittering blue icicles like teeth, a frost-eyed maw shape in the rock, and a numeral-six knight lowering his sword to breathe warm mist on the ice while trapped traders watch.
solution: Each swing removes 2 but 3 regrow, so the net change is 3 - 2 = +1 icicle per swing.
praise: Tracking both the removing and the regrowing was exactly the right instinct — the missing step was combining them into one net change of +1 per swing.
